title: Project Foundation
description:
Scaffold Rust project with core dependencies, CLI structure, and configuration loading. Sets up the basic infrastructure for opencode-multiview.

Includes:
- Cargo.toml with all dependencies (clap, figment2, jiff, serde, watchman_client, etc.)
- Basic src/ structure
- CLI argument definitions
- Config loading from TOML + env vars

title: Session Discovery & Parsing
description:
Implement session data access layer. Find and parse opencode session JSON files from `~/.local/share/opencode/storage/session/`.

Key components:
- Session schema structs (Session, SessionTime, SessionSummary)
- Session file discovery via glob
- Session parser implementation
- Project ID computation (SHA1 of worktree path)

title: Real-time Updates
description:
Integrate watchman_client for efficient file watching. Subscribe to session file changes and provide live updates.

Key components:
- watchman_client connection and subscription
- Expression matching for `storage/session/*/*.json`
- Change event handling
- Graceful fallback when watchman unavailable
- Session status tracking (idle/busy/retry)

title: Filtering System
description:
Implement filtering logic for sessions by time, project patterns, and recent changes.

Key components:
- Time filtering with jiff (relative: `2d`, `1h`, absolute: ISO)
- Project pattern matching (glob/regex, colon-separated)
- Recent mode with state persistence
- Field selection (`-f` option)

title: Profile System
description:
Implement profile management with TOML config files.

Key components:
- TOML profile files in `~/.config/om/profiles/`
- Profile loading/saving
- Environment variable overrides (OM_* prefix)
- `om profiles` subcommand for profile management
- Live profile switching in TUI

title: Inline Mode
description:
Primary output mode for session display. Fixed-height inline display - the default and most common usage pattern.

Key components:
- Basic session list output with ANSI formatting
- Height management (`--height`)
- Oneshot mode (`-1`) for print-and-exit
- Scrollback preservation for inline mode

title: Fullscreen TUI
description:
Interactive fullscreen mode using FrankenTUI for live session monitoring.

Key components:
- FrankenTUI integration
- Live session view with auto-refresh
- Keyboard controls: `[`, `]` navigate, `p` project select, `s`/`S` save profile, `a` activate
- Tool overlay system with configurable height
- Fuzzy finder for project selection

title: Shell Hook Integration
description:
Fast execution mode for shell hooks. Optimized for non-interactive use in shell init/hooks.

Key components:
- Fast oneshot execution
- Current project detection from working directory
- Recent changes tracking (`-r`) with state persistence
- State storage in `~/.local/share/om/state/`
- Minimal output mode

title: Output Modes
description:
Support multiple output formats for scripting and tool integration.

Key components:
- JSON lines output (`-j`) to stdout, controls via stderr
- Field customization (`-f`)
- Quiet mode (`-q`) and verbose mode (`-v`)
- Configurable output fields

title: Define CLI arguments with clap
description: Implement all CLI options from README: before, after, num, recent, projects, profile, current, srcs, fullscreen, fields, json, oneshot, quiet, verbose, height, tool-height. Include subcommands for `profiles`.

title: Implement config loading with figment2
description: Load config from TOML files + environment variables (OM_* prefix). Support XDG-compliant paths.

title: Implement current project detection
description: Detect current project from working directory by matching against known project paths.

title: Implement field selection
description: Allow users to select which session fields to display via `-f` option.

title: Integrate FrankenTUI
description: Set up FrankenTUI for fullscreen mode. Implement basic rendering loop.

title: Implement fuzzy finder for project selection
description: Use fuzzy-matcher crate for project filtering. Display in tool overlay.

title: Implement inline session output
description: Format session list with ANSI colors. Respect `--height` limit. Handle multiple sessions.

title: Implement JSON lines output
description: Output JSON lines to stdout (`-j`), UI controls via stderr. For scripting/integration.

title: Implement keyboard controls
description: Handle keys: `[`, `]` navigate, `p` project select, `s`/`S` save profile, `a` activate session.

title: Implement oneshot mode
description: Print session output once and exit (no live updates). Used for `-1` flag.

title: Implement profile TOML storage
description: Read/write profile configs to `~/.config/om/profiles/<name>.toml`. Handle defaults.

title: Implement `om profiles` subcommand
description: Create/update profile configurations from CLI. Support multiple profile names.

title: Implement project pattern filtering
description: Parse colon-separated project patterns. Support glob matching against project paths/names.

title: Implement project ID computation
description: Compute SHA1 hash of worktree path to derive project ID. Needed for mapping sessions to projects.

title: Implement quiet and verbose modes
description: Control logging verbosity with `-q` (quiet) and `-v` (verbose) flags.

title: Implement recent mode tracking
description: Persist last-run timestamps. Compare sessions to show only new/changed since last run.

title: Implement recent state persistence
description: Store last-seen state in `~/.local/share/om/state/`. Fast read/write for shell hooks.

title: Scaffold Cargo project
description: Create Cargo.toml with dependencies: clap (v4 + derive), figment2, jiff, serde, serde_json, watchman_client, tracing, bon, sha1, glob

title: Implement session file discovery
description: Glob `~/.local/share/opencode/storage/session/*/*.json` to find all session files. Handle concurrent access.

title: Implement session parser
description: Parse session JSON files into Session structs. Handle malformed files gracefully.

title: Define session schema structs
description: Create Session, SessionTime, SessionSummary structs with serde derive. Match opencode's JSON format.

title: Implement session status tracking
description: Track idle/busy/retry status for sessions. Parse status from session data or logs.

title: Implement time filtering with jiff
description: Parse relative time (`2d`, `1h`, `30m`) and absolute ISO timestamps. Filter sessions by created/updated time.

title: Implement watchman fallback to polling
description: When watchman unavailable, fall back to periodic polling of session files.

title: Implement watchman subscription
description: Connect to watchman, subscribe to `storage/session/*/*.json` with expression matching. Handle connection failures.
